WITH cust_orders AS ( SELECT c_custkey, c_nationkey, COUNT(*) AS order_cnt, SUM(o_totalprice) AS total FROM customer JOIN orders ON c_custkey = o_custkey WHERE o_orderdate >= DATE '1994-04-01' GROUP BY c_custkey, c_nationkey ), nation_stats AS ( SELECT c_nationkey, AVG(total) AS avg_total, STDDEV(total) AS sd_total FROM cust_orders GROUP BY c_nationkey ) SELECT n_name, co.c_custkey, co.total, ROUND((co.total - ns.avg_total) / NULLIF(ns.sd_total, 0), 2) AS z_score FROM cust_orders co JOIN nation_stats ns ON co.c_nationkey = ns.c_nationkey JOIN nation ON co.c_nationkey = n_nationkey WHERE co.total > ns.avg_total + COALESCE(ns.sd_total, 0) ORDER BY z_score DESC LIMIT 5;
